newsitem.title: USA: Auspex sees weak short-term earnings.
newsitem.headline: Auspex sees weak short-term earnings.

text.p: Auspex Systems Inc said Thursday it will continue to ramp up its investments to support a very aggressive product rollout in the coming year which will result in weak short term earnings.

The company said in a statement it sees modest revenue growth in the first half of fiscal 1998 and that starting in the second fiscal quarter it should experience accelerated growth in the second half of the year.
The company did not specify either how large its investment would be or the potential impact on earnings.

Auspex Thursday reported a loss of $2.24 million, or $0.09 a share, compared to a profit of $6.2 million, or $0.24 a share, in the comparable year-ago period. Revenues increased to $49.1 million from $43.1 million a ayer-ago.
Results for the latest fourth quarter included a charge of $7.4 million or $0.30 a share related to the acquisition of Alphatronix Inc.
